description:
Cast Sink into Takenuma by paying its mana cost, targeting yourself.
Holding priority, cast Desperate Ritual by paying its splice cost, adding its effects onto Sink into Takenuma.
Holding priority, activate Mirror Sheen by paying {1}{U/R}{U/R}, copying Sink into Takenuma, which also has the effects of Desperate Ritual, targeting a player
Resolve Sink into Takenuma, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.
